evidence: The ALD of MS2 (M = Fe, Co, Ni) films was carried out in a home-built tubular reactor using bis(N,N′-di-tertbutylacetamidinato)M(II) (i.e. M(amd) 2) as the metal precursors (Scheme 1), and the H2S plasma was generated by supplying a radio frequency power on a diluted H 2S (3% in Ar) gas flow.
